sources.note: Nothing on Medebur stress. Medebur appears only in Schouten-chain sound-correspondence tables and cognate sets (ch.5) and pronominal tables; data are Ross's own from informants Kilope Bador and Cornelius Bogomos (App. A p.395); Medebur is absent from App. B (no written sources). Stress is discussed only for Ali/Sissano lenition (3.115), not Medebur.
